commandLine:
source $HOME/.bash_profile;
if [ $UseBusinessDate == 0 ]; then
  cat <(listado -e C0_NUMX_INDEX) <(listado -e C0_NUMX_DEPOSIT) | ac_consolidate_prices.pl -c Pc_MultiSource_Numerix_Index -t 163000 -
else
  cat <(listado -e C0_NUMX_INDEX) <(listado -e C0_NUMX_DEPOSIT) | ac_consolidate_prices.pl -d $BusinessDate -c Pc_MultiSource_Numerix_Index -t 163000 -
fi
